clauses.current_legal_basis: Rule VIII as added by EO 10641 and amended by EO 12107 remains the source of overseas limited appointments: 5 CFR part 301, subpart B (eCFR as of 2026-10-14; jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/cfr-t5-part301.txt) implements overseas limited appointments of U.S. citizens recruited overseas or outside overseas areas, and its authority line and that of 5 CFR 301.206 cite E.O. 10577 as amended by E.O. 10641; authority statutes 5 U.S.C. 3301 and 3302 (held current texts usc-t5-s3301.txt, usc-t5-s3302.txt) remain in force; the bounded USC, eCFR and OFR-catalog searches found no ending through 2026-10-14.
clauses.reason: The clause adds Rule VIII: the Commission may authorize recruitment and appointment to overseas positions (8.1); U.S. citizens recruited overseas may receive overseas limited appointments, excluded from the Civil Service Retirement Act unless otherwise eligible (8.2); non-citizens may be appointed without regard to the Civil Service Act (8.3); Hawaii, Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, Alaska and the Isthmus of Panama are excepted (8.4). EO 12107 sec. 2-101(a), effective January 1, 1979, substituted agency names (Office of Personnel Management for Civil Service Commission), so the clause continues amended. 5 CFR part 301 subpart B implements 8.1 and 8.2 as of 2026-10-14 and cites EO 10641 as authority.

research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 10641 of October 26, 1955, 20 FR 8137 (Oct. 29, 1955), held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10641.txt (FR Doc. 55-8799); it amends the Civil Service Rules by adding Rule VIII, appointments to overseas positions (8.1 to 8.4). Later instruments: EO 12107 (Dec. 28, 1978; 44 FR 1055) sec. 2-101(a) lists EO 10641 among orders amended and revised by substituting Office of Personnel Management for Civil Service Commission, effective January 1, 1979 (secs. 2-104 and 2-404). Its sec. 2-401 asks for a report by July 1, 1981 on continuing, modifying or revoking the listed orders; a report deadline is not an end and no held report or action follows. Number searches of held texts find only EO 10577 (earlier cross reference), EO 12107, the 5 CFR part 301 authority lines and the 5 U.S.C. 3301 note (which lists EO 10641 as amended by EO 12107). No held Revoked by or Superseded by note exists (OFR notes record amendment by EO 12107). Bounded searches read for coverage: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121 USLM text and notes, citations of the order by number, edition current through 2026-10-09, laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts).
